name: NORG Pod opening
doc: NORG Pod opening (the NORG Pod's enemy attack; the act family, Drain's master): the stage light ramps up, then one emitter per action - its sound, the pod's shell (the caster's bone 1) thrown off with the stage wobble and the caster's chain transformation, debris sprites and prim-model chunks from it, the damage; after the last action a wait, the light ramps down. Its parts are the port's code (FFNx mag020_norg_pod_opening.cpp) run on the program's memory.

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions and uses this memory.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs (its tasks the port's, its parts spawned by them): its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

act.doc: Drain's master in the act family's form: once its children are gone the stage light ramp up; after the last action its wait, the ramp down (no actor pools)

pools.doc: the lid and its debris sprites (the port's)

parts.title: Emitter
parts.doc: One per action: its sound, the master's release, the damage; the master's wait and the stage light ramps

parts.title: Lid
parts.doc: The pod's shell (the caster's bone 1) thrown off, and its debris

groups.label: Stage light
groups.doc: Its ramps up (before the first action) and down (after the wait): Step a tick, Level

groups.label: Velocity
groups.doc: The lid's first velocity a tick (x, y: negative up, z)

params.label: Release tick
params.doc: The master may start the next action at this tick

params.label: Damage tick
params.doc: The action's result from this tick

params.label: Wait
params.doc: After the last action, the light ramp down after these ticks

params.label: Start tick
params.doc: It flies off (the stage wobble, the caster's chain transformation) from this tick

params.label: Flight ticks
params.doc: Its flight lasts these ticks (then the caster's presence 6)

params.label: Gravity
params.doc: Added to its y velocity a tick

params.label: Flipbook 1629C54
params.doc: The sprite sequence at 0x1629C54 (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Model 1629E00
params.doc: The prim model at 0x1629E00 (a mesh of 4 vertices, 1 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

tasks.doc: One per action: the module's own emitter (the port's task): its sound, the lid, the master's release, the damage.
The stage light ramp up (the port's task: the four stage light words up a step a tick to the level).
The stage light ramp down (the port's task: from the level down a step a tick to 0).
